component.name: HTTPlug Discovery
component.summary: Finds and installs PSR-7, PSR-17, PSR-18 and HTTPlug implementations

description.p: Runtime discovery mechanism that locates installed PSR-7/PSR-17/PSR-18 HTTP message, factory, and client implementations (e.g. nyholm/psr7) so libraries do not have to hard-depend on one specific implementation. Used by the OpenTelemetry PHP SDK's OTLP exporter.
